Create one production concept image for the Career World ambient map asset "Marker Buoy". This is a reusable, map-scale navigation prop, never a building or scene. It must remain subordinate to skills, projects, and city capitals while still being mechanically specific and instantly readable. Domain summary: A compact generic marker buoy whose recognizable structure combines a weighted faceted body, narrow mast, open top cage, two opposing stabilizer fins, and a tight diamond-shaped footprint. Accepted baseline identity: A faceted weighted buoy body supports a narrow mast, a small open top cage, and two opposing stabilizer fins on a compact diamond footprint.

Exploration 1 — Canonical Production: refine the accepted baseline into its clearest production-ready map prop. Specifically emphasize this researched quality: weighted faceted body. Keep the buoy neutral. Do not assign a navigation code, warning class, color meaning, ownership, direction, location, or active state.

Show exactly one complete buoy with exactly two opposing fins. No water, waves, chain, seabed, boat, beacon glow, signal symbols, numbers, color bands, or detached components.

Restrained wireframe product line art, matte low-value faces, crisp traced edges, fine construction lines, controlled functional detail, no glow. One image only: no second panel, thumbnails, inset, silhouette swatch, contact sheet, exploded view, or alternate angle. Center the entire prop with generous margin and show it completely inside frame. Preserve the requested object and component count exactly.
